messages:
carla: dropping a tiny 'paste-ready' review clipboard for people who hate verbose forms — IC one-liners + manager micro-notes. kept to 1-2 lines per section so it can be copied straight into the form. :scissors:

henry: love the brevity. can we add a hiring-linked bullet for ICs who mentored new hires?
lia: also add a short policy/benefits line for folks who owned compliance docs.
carla: good call both. added two tiny examples and a manager follow-up template.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: calibration packet due next Wed — tag thread_ts to request inclusion.

carla: --- IC PASTE CLIPBOARD (copy/paste 1-2 lines) ---
- One-line summary: "I reduced model tail latency for high-concurrency routes by improving caching and scheduling."
- Impact metric (1 line): "p99 latency down 760ms -> 240ms; customer error-rate reduced 0.9% -> 0.2%."
- Hiring/mentorship line (optional): "Mentored 2 new infra hires; they shipped on-call playbooks in 3 weeks."
- Policy/compliance line (optional): "Authored data retention doc to meet SOC2 timeline; removed 80% manual reviews."
- What I'd change (1 line): "Start perf experiments earlier in the dev cycle to reduce canary rollbacks."

carla: --- MANAGER MICRO-NOTES (paste 2 lines) ---
- Observation: "Delivered measurable latency and reliability gains; validated in canary with zero regressions."
- Next action: "Assign owner for runbook adoption and schedule a 3-week validation checkpoint."

carla: --- STRETCH VS COMMIT (one-liners) ---
- Committed: "Met agreed KRs and owned rollout for the feature."
- Stretch: "Influenced cross-org strategy, lifted team delivery, and reduced org-level failure modes."

carla: --- PEER ASK DM (one-line templates) ---
- Quick ask: "Hey @NAME — can you drop 2 lines on how I handled the rollout (clarity + handoff)? Much appreciated!"
- Short praise: "If you have a sec, could you note one thing I did well on the project?"

carla: --- MINI CALIBRATION PROMPT FOR MANAGERS (5 bullets, one-line each) ---
- Tie claims to a dashboard or test artifact, not just memory.
- Prefer time-bound metrics (before/after windows).
- Separate individual contribution from team effort.
- Confirm the candidate's growth ask is specific and time-boxed.
- For hiring-linked claims, verify mentee outcomes (did they ship?).

henry: this is super usable. i trimmed it down and shared with my direct reports.
lia: perfect for policy folks too — helped me craft a SOC2-friendly snippet.
carla: great! if folks want, i can make a PM/designer variant with different metric examples.
people-ops-bot: Tip: to embed these as quick templates in the review form, open a ticket and reference this thread_ts.
